target_customer: Teams building and shipping AI voice agents
problem: Finding bugs in voice agents such as hallucinations, interruptions, transcription errors and latency meant hours of manual test calls.
business_model: Free open source Python package, paid optional cloud platform to visualize test results (per the Show HN post)

founders.name: Oliver Wendell-Braly
prior_employers: PlayHT (voice agent developer, per the launch post)
founders.background_notes: Education not found. His YC profile later lists Clarus (clarus.finance) as a company, with fixa as a past launch.

founders.name: Jonathan
prior_employers: PlayHT (voice agent developer, per the launch post)
founders.background_notes: Last name not given in the sources opened.

technical_complexity.rationale: Simulating phone calls against voice agents and analyzing transcripts, latency and interruptions needed telephony and speech stack integration, but was achievable by two engineers as an open source package.

defensibility.rationale: The core tool was released free and open source, so copying was easy and the founders said the paid feature did not make sense as a monetization model.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent move found in sources. Several YC peers (Hamming AI, Cekura) targeted the same wedge in the same period.

market_need_then: Voice agent developers described spending long stretches hunting bugs by hand; the Show HN post got 12 points and Product Hunt launch drew 240 upvotes in January 2025, indicating developer interest.

branding.domain_note: fixa.dev was used at launch; the domain now hosts an unrelated AI software engineer product by a different founder (Product Hunt, April 2026).

identity.voice_and_tone: Casual developer voice with emoji in the launch post

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch on 2025-01-08 ranked sixth of the day with 240 upvotes; Show HN post.

brand_strength.rationale: Modest developer buzz at launch but the name is shared with a later unrelated product on the same domain, and no brand assets were documented.

outcome_analysis: Fixa launched as an open source voice agent testing tool in January 2025 and gained early developer attention, but the founders gave the core away for free and the status afterward is unclear. The founder's YC profile now lists a different company, Clarus, which suggests the project was not the long term focus, though no source states why or confirms a shutdown.
notes: VCBacked lists a $500K pre-seed in December 2024 with Y Combinator only; single aggregator, unverified, probably the standard YC deal, so not recorded as a round. fixa.dev now serves a different product, so the live site is not this company. Competitor searches returned only 2026 comparisons, so no dated competitor list exists near the batch (Fall 2024). Status Active per YC directory, but the YC profile of the CEO lists Clarus as a newer company. Completeness pass: the $500K pre-seed of December 2024 is recorded from VCBacked alone; it lists only Y Combinator and may be the standard YC deal. A second search found no other source.
